pyramiding_rule: Strictly prohibit adding to positions within 1.5 ATR of a recent liquidity swing high/low; only pyramid when existing position is at least +$10 in profit and trailing stop locks in breakeven.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Mandatory ATR-based buffer: Initial stop-loss for XAUUSD must never be set closer than 1.2 * 14-period ATR from the execution price to filter out micro-noise wicks.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate aggressive trailing harvest protocols only after floating profit crosses +$15.00, targeting a minimum R-multiple expansion of 4:1.
